meta.description: Langar First. The vision continues. Projects underway: a dedicated dairy farm, patient-specific hospital meals, ambulances on Punjab’s major highways, and a world-class charitable hospital with an October 2034 target.

hero.title: Langar First. The vision continues.
hero.lede: Building toward a connected model of nutrition, emergency response and charitable healthcare across Punjab — with Langar always at the centre.

hospital.title: A world-class charitable hospital.
hospital.body: Land has been acquired for a future hospital built around United States-level systems, management and standards of care. Our goal is to break ground in October 2034, commemorating the 550th birth anniversary of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
hospital.note: This vision is still being developed. Clinical scope, architecture, funding and timelines will be shared publicly as they are finalized.

follow.title: Watch the vision take shape.
follow.body: We share updates on YouTube, Instagram and Facebook as each project moves forward.

india.q: How can I contribute from within India?
india.a: Use the bank transfer details or send a cheque to our Hoshiarpur office — both are listed above.

outside.q: How can I contribute from outside India?
outside.a: Please do not use the India account. Email us and our team will guide you.

receipt.q: Will I get a confirmation receipt?
receipt.a: Yes — email info@langarsewa.org and our team will send one.

visit.a: Yes — visitors are welcome between 6:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Reach out first so we can plan your visit.

volunteer.q: Can I volunteer at a hospital near me?
volunteer.a: Tell us where you are and we’ll connect you with the nearest service point.

meta.description: Our story — Dhan Guru Ramdas Langar Sewa: the tradition of Langar, our journey, our kitchens, and where we’re going.

hero.title: Sewa, carried forward.
hero.body: Dhan Guru Ramdas Langar Sewa is rooted in the Sikh tradition of Langar: nourishment offered with equality, dignity and devotion. Our mission is to ensure no individual lacks access to adequate nutrition in Punjab.
hero.photoAlt: Painting of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
hero.caption: Sri Guru Ram Das Ji

journey.title: How we got here, and where we’re going.
journey.body: Each step grew from a real need — first in hospitals, then wherever people were going without.

tradition.title: One kitchen. Every person. No distinction.
tradition.body: Langar is a community kitchen where anyone — regardless of caste, religion, ethnicity or economic status — is served a free meal. It embodies equality and the oneness of all humanity.

visit.title: Come see the sewa for yourself.
visit.body: Visit our kitchen in Pur Heeran and see the preparation, the hygiene and the people behind every meal.
visit.photoAlt: Pur Heeran kitchen grounds and entrance

hero.title: Sewa in action.
hero.lede: Daily Langar at hospitals is the foundation. Around it, a growing network supports healthcare, education, emergency response and community needs.

langar.title: Two kitchens. One daily commitment.
langar.body: About 100,000 meals are served every day: about 65,000 prepared at Pur Heeran, Hoshiarpur and 35,000 at Madhir, Sri Muktsar Sahib.
langar.imageAlt: Cooking hall with large Langar cauldrons, Pur Heeran

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.text: Roti machines and commercial kitchens at Pur Heeran and Madhir.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.text: About 30 vehicles on fixed daily routes, plus a ration truck between kitchens.

serve.title: Serve
serve.text: Two meals plus tea and biscuits, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
